parameters.name: Filters
parameters.description: A list of conditions to filter chat configurations.

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description: The name of the filter condition.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the filter condition.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page for a paged query.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token to retrieve the next page of results. Set this parameter to the \`NextToken\` value from the previous response.
